title: Cryptoassets standard and other miscellaneous amendments: consultation on return templates — Return template: MA(BS)3a Part I
summary: HKMA's document ledger lists this item as 'Return template: MA(BS)3a Part I,' issued 13 June 2025 as part of the same wider package as its sibling MA(BS)3 return-template documents, titled 'Cryptoassets standard and other miscellaneous amendments: consultation on return templates.' That package consults Authorized Institutions on proposed new or amended banking return forms, incorporating a prudential 'cryptoassets standard' for how banks report cryptoasset exposures, alongside separate, unrelated housekeeping changes; MA(BS)3a is a distinct return form from MA(BS)3, so this annex proposes its own specific template content rather than duplicating that sibling return. HKMA's document repository (brdr.hkma.gov.hk) returned a server error (HTTP 503) on every attempt to retrieve this document during this review, so the specific changes proposed to this particular return are not confirmed against its own text; this summary is limited to what HKMA's own consultations feed listing for this item states.
why_it_matters: HKMA requires the banks it supervises to file standardised prudential returns, and this is another of the forms being amended specifically to capture cryptoasset exposure. For a newcomer, it shows the cryptoassets standard reaching across multiple separate return forms, not just a single one.
